items.title: Thousands struggling without water after a major leak in a pipeline in Kolkata’s Tala area
items.text: More than 5 million gallons of water gushed out after the 72-inch pipeline was damaged on November 9, according to the Kolkata Municipal Corporation; the leak disrupted water supply across several central Kolkata neighbourhoods.

items.title: Ambekar Meetei storms into men’s 50kg final at Youth Olympics
items.text: Lairenlakpam Ambekar Meetei beat Colombia’s Izzon Jeffrey Galea Arevalo 5–0 in the men’s 50 kg semifinal at Dakar 2026, reaching the Youth Olympics boxing final and ending a 16-year wait for an Indian boxer.

items.title: Aaryavir in focus as India face Afghanistan in U-19 Asia Cup semifinal
items.text: Aaryavir Sehwag scored 160 off 168 balls to lead India to a 70-run win over the UAE in their final Group A match, finishing as the tournament’s leading run-scorer before the semifinal.

items.title: Anti-Sterlite protests: CM orders ₹5.25-cr. additional relief to victims
items.text: The Tamil Nadu Chief Minister ordered ₹5.25 crore in additional relief for victims of the Thoothukudi anti-Sterlite protests; the report says compensation rises to ₹50 lakh for each deceased victim’s family and ₹10 lakh for grievously injured victims.

items.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak exceeds 11,000 cases, causes 5,387 deaths
items.text: By November 11, 2026, official figures showed 11,042 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,387 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo; armed conflict was hampering the public-health response.
